captures.q: tell me about Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire
captures.description: ATTRIBUTED CORRECTLY TO REBEKAH CRANES, without collapse, on the same surface and auth state where the query for Cranes herself returned a Titus County Fair scholarship recipient. Reads the five movements — First Rays, Bright Morning and the rest — the calls-and-responses structure with Catullus 51 as a Latin response to Sappho 31, the preservation of lacunae rather than pretended completeness, and Sappho placed beside Corinna and Alcman rather than as isolated genius. Quotes the translation: 'my soft tongue snaps in half'. Dates the original publication to New Human Press 2013 with a 2026 archived edition.
